name: hcapp_getTrackImportUploadToken
description: Authenticates the device for GetTrackImportUploadToken and returns the hasher id that names the blob folder (E5.F5.S7). Same shape as hcapp_getProfilePhotoUploadToken. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 99, @param NULL). Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with User.
Paired with ErrorEnvelope on auth failure. Not present on success.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 56-58, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. A client that omits either gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs — instead of ValidateAppAuth's logged auth error.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
